The `debug:autoconfiguration` command proposed in #67237 will display the first docblock line of each type and attribute registered for autoconfiguration, like `debug:autowiring` does.

Like #66566 did for autowiring, this PR adds the missing lines (17) and rewrites the weak ones (32), eg "Service tag to autoconfigure commands". The deprecated `RouteLoaderInterface` is left untouched.
